import json
with open('/work/output/artifacts/skill-flow-remove-node/BellevueWeather/BellevueWeather/BellevueWeather.flow') as f:
    flow = json.load(f)

# Validate structure
node_ids = [n['id'] for n in flow['nodes']]
print('Nodes:', node_ids)

edge_ids = [(e['sourceNodeId'], e['targetNodeId']) for e in flow['edges']]
print('Edges:', edge_ids)

var_node_ids = [v['id'] for v in flow['variables']['nodes']]
print('Variable nodes:', var_node_ids)

layout_node_ids = list(flow['layout']['nodes'].keys())
print('Layout nodes:', layout_node_ids)

# Check no formatSummary anywhere
import re
raw = open('/work/output/artifacts/skill-flow-remove-node/BellevueWeather/BellevueWeather/BellevueWeather.flow').read()
assert 'formatSummary' not in raw, 'formatSummary still present!'

# Validate decision expression
decision = next(n for n in flow['nodes'] if n['id'] == 'checkTemperature')
assert 'getWeather.output.body.current.temperature_2m' in decision['inputs']['expression'], 'Decision expression wrong'
print('Decision expression:', decision['inputs']['expression'])

# Validate end node expressions
nice = next(n for n in flow['nodes'] if n['id'] == 'endNiceDay')
jacket = next(n for n in flow['nodes'] if n['id'] == 'endBringJacket')
assert 'getWeather.output.body.current.temperature_2m' in nice['outputs']['summary']['source']['expression']
assert 'getWeather.output.body.current.temperature_2m' in jacket['outputs']['summary']['source']['expression']
print('endNiceDay expression:', nice['outputs']['summary']['source']['expression'])
print('endBringJacket expression:', jacket['outputs']['summary']['source']['expression'])

# Validate edges
assert any(e['sourceNodeId'] == 'getWeather' and e['targetNodeId'] == 'checkTemperature' for e in flow['edges']), 'Missing direct edge getWeather->checkTemperature'
assert not any('formatSummary' in str(e) for e in flow['edges']), 'formatSummary still in edges'

print()
print('All validations passed!')
"
